title: Detailed aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-blue fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='38' ry='7' fill='#4db8ff'/>
  <!-- lighter top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49.5' rx='34' ry='3.5' fill='#a8dcff'/>
  <!-- tail fin vertical -->
  <path d='M82 52 L88 34 L93 34 L92 52 Z' fill='#2a8fd6'/>
  <!-- horizontal stabilizer -->
  <path d='M84 52 L95 48 L95 52 L84 54 Z' fill='#7ccfff'/>
  <!-- main wing top -->
  <path d='M38 44 L52 30 L68 30 L58 46 Z' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <!-- main wing bottom -->
  <path d='M38 60 L52 74 L68 74 L58 58 Z' fill='#b0d8f0'/>
  <!-- wing stripe details -->
  <line x1='44' y1='40' x2='62' y2='32' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='64' x2='62' y2='72' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='49' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#1a4a6e'/>
  <!-- cockpit window shine -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='48' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <!-- nose cone -->
  <path d='M12 52 Q8 52 8 49 Q8 46 14 47 Z' fill='#ff6644'/>
  <!-- engine under wing (top) -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='47' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#8a9aa8'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='46.5' rx='4' ry='1.5' fill='#c0d0dc'/>
  <!-- engine under wing (bottom) -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='57' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#8a9aa8'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='57.5' rx='4' ry='1.5' fill='#c0d0dc'/>
  <!-- fuselage windows -->
  <rect x='28' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='33' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='38' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='43' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='48' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='53' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='58' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='63' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='68' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='73' y='51' width='2' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <!-- tail fin accent -->
  <path d='M85 52 L88 38 L91 38 L90 52 Z' fill='#ff9944'/>
  <!-- exhaust trail -->
  <circle cx='6' cy='52' r='2' fill='#d0e8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='1' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#d0e8ff' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- landing gear -->
  <line x1='40' y1='59' x2='38' y2='64' stroke='#8a9aa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='65' r='2' fill='#333a45'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='59' x2='62' y2='64' stroke='#8a9aa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='65' r='2' fill='#333a45'/>
  <!-- wing tip lights -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='74' r='1.5' fill='#44ff44'/>
</svg>
